after: A single Python script now runs on every deploy: it creates docker/.env.sit from the template only if missing, then merges any template key missing from an existing file into that file (fixing the stale-template problem for good).

Verified live on this deploy run: first invocation (run 28894879108) merged exactly the 12 previously-missing keys (DEFAULT_LOCALE, OCR_ENGINE, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, STAGE_C_BACKUP_MODELS, STAGE_C_DEFAULT_MODEL, STAGE_C_ESCALATION_MODEL, STAGE_C_FREE_CONF_THRESHOLD, STAGE_C_FREE_DAILY_USD_CAP, STAGE_C_FREE_MODELS, STAGE_C_PAID_DAILY_USD_CAP, STAGE_C_PROVIDER, STAGE_C_USE_IMAGE_INPUT) into the already-existing docker/.env.sit, printing only key names (`keys_changed_count=12`, `keys_changed_names=...`), never values.
Second invocation (run 28895219576, the successful completed run) shows `keys_changed_count=0` - confirms the merge is idempotent once applied.
The new 'Verify required runtime config presence' step confirms all 21 required keys are now present_non_empty as real env vars on the backend container (see 'Verification run' below).

CHANGE_ME collision fix.problem: The old `sed -i "s/CHANGE_ME/sk-ant-local-sit/g"` blanket substring replace would also match the `CHANGE_ME` substring inside `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-CHANGE_ME`, corrupting it into `sk-ant-sk-ant-local-sit` on any fresh docker/.env.sit creation.
CHANGE_ME collision fix.fix: The new Python script resolves placeholder secrets by exact whole-value match only (value == 'CHANGE_ME', not substring-contains). A value of 'sk-ant-CHANGE_ME' does not exactly equal 'CHANGE_ME' and is left untouched instead of corrupted.
CHANGE_ME collision fix.additional_fix: DATABASE_URL (a composite value that embeds POSTGRES_PASSWORD as a substring) is no longer touched by any placeholder/substring logic at all - it is deterministically rebuilt from its resolved POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_PASSWORD/POSTGRES_DB parts after those are resolved, eliminating the substring-surgery risk entirely for that key.
CHANGE_ME collision fix.local_verification: Simulated the new logic locally with representative template values (POSTGRES_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-CHANGE_ME, OPENROUTER_API_KEY=CHANGE_ME, DATABASE_URL with embedded CHANGE_ME) before pushing: confirmed ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stayed exactly 'sk-ant-CHANGE_ME' (no corruption), OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolved to a real random 32-char hex value, and DATABASE_URL was correctly rebuilt with the new random password substituted in place.
